user.title: Eneco Belgium
user.description: Sign in with the account you use on eneco.be.

data_description.email: The email address of your My Eneco account.
data_description.password: Accounts protected by two-factor authentication cannot be used.

account.title: Account
account.description: Choose the account whose meter readings you want to submit.

address.title: Address
address.description: Choose the delivery address of the meter.

meter.title: Meter
meter.description: Choose the meter to submit readings for.

sources.title: Meter readings
sources.description: Choose the sensor that holds the meter index for each register of EAN {ean}. Every sensor must report a total index, not a rate. Leave a register empty and it is simply not submitted, which is what a meter you still read by hand needs.

data_description.submit_time: Local time of day at which the readings are sent, once a day.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Eneco no longer accepts the stored password for {email}. If that address is not your My Eneco login any more, close this and choose Reconfigure instead.

error.no_accounts: Signed in, but this login has no Eneco account that can submit meter readings.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Eneco portal.

abort.already_configured: This meter is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This meter is already being set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Eneco portal: {error}
abort.no_addresses: This account has no address with an active contract.
abort.no_meters: There is no electricity or gas meter at this address.
abort.no_registers: Eneco does not accept meter readings for this meter.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different meter than the one this entry was set up for.

init.title: Meter readings
init.description: Choose the sensor that holds the meter index for each register, and when to submit. Leave a register empty and it is simply not submitted, which is what a meter you still read by hand needs.

data_description.submit_time: Local time of day at which the readings are sent, once a day.

submission_failed.title: Meter readings are not reaching Eneco
submission_failed.description:
{name} has failed to submit its meter readings {count} times in a row. The last reason was: {error}

Open the integration and check the status sensor, the sensors you chose as sources, and whether Eneco still accepts your sign in.
